name: io.github.hpasic/nordnet-mcp
title: Nordnet Portfolio
description: Read-only Nordnet brokerage data: accounts, positions, trades, balances, orders, instruments.

environmentVariables.name: NORDNET_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Nordnet API host for your market, e.g. public.nordnet.se, public.nordnet.no, public.nordnet.dk, public.nordnet.fi

environmentVariables.name: NORDNET_SESSION_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional session token; omit to sign in via QR code with the nordnet_auth tool

environmentVariables.name: NORDNET_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional; set to NEXT if Nordnet returns NEXT_INVALID_SESSION
